newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA SETS CLOCKS TO SUMMER TIME MARCH 30.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA SETS CLOCKS TO SUMMER TIME MARCH 30.

text.p: Clocks in Bulgaria would be set one hour ahead on March 30 as the country moves to summer time, a government press official said.
"The government decided that all clocks should be moved one hour ahead at 0300 local time on the last Sunday of March," the official told reporters. The new local time becomes GMT plus three hours.
Bulgaria will move back to winter time or two hours ahead of GMT on the last Sunday of October. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
